question: On the established SmallViT central two-block span, can an 8/32-dimensional teacher correction plus a complementary 24D Canaria self-anchor robustly repair the recursive boundary across fresh model seeds and fresh bases with bounded loss relative to full 32D hidden alignment?
recursive_target_rule: After alignment, freeze cluster and fit final candidate from cluster outputs only; original hidden targets forbidden as final recursive target.
test_isolation: Held-out test dataset is materialized for endpoint evaluation only after all fitting and validation metrics for the seed are complete.

endpoints.validation_safeguard: paired bootstrap95 lower(min_basis anchored8 val accuracy - full32 val accuracy) > -0.04
endpoints.test_safeguard: paired bootstrap95 lower(min_basis anchored8 test accuracy - full32 test accuracy) > -0.04

overall_decision: CONFIRMATORY_PASS requires >=8 eligible seeds and all five locked gates PASS. No rescue seeds, bases, margins, update counts, or alternate aggregations.
claim_boundary_if_pass: Scoped SmallViT central-two-block quarter-interface result only; not full-model Transformer compression, arbitrary architectures/subspaces, LLM behavior, or a universal 8D interface.
